frases.it: Dopo la visita, il medico consiglia di bere molta acqua e riposare per due giorni.
frases.es: Tras la consulta, el médico aconseja beber mucha agua y descansar durante dos días.
frases.en: After consultation, the doctor advises you to drink a lot of water and rest for two days.

frases.it: Prenda una compressa dopo pranzo e una dopo cena con un bicchiere d'acqua.
frases.es: Tome un comprimido después de la comida y otro después de la cena con un vaso de agua.
frases.en: Take one tablet after lunch and another after dinner with a glass of water.

frases.it: Non superi due compresse al giorno per nessun motivo.
frases.es: No supere dos comprimidos al día por ningún motivo.
frases.en: Do not exceed two tablets per day for any reason.

frases.it: Se la febbre continua dopo venerdì, telefoni allo studio medico.
frases.es: Si la fiebre continúa después del viernes, llame por teléfono a la consulta médica.
frases.en: If the fever continues after Friday, call the doctor's office.

frases.it: Per il controllo non serve un nuovo appuntamento: passi in ambulatorio tra le nove e le undici.
frases.es: Para la revisión no hace falta una nueva cita: pase por la consulta entre las nueve y las once.
frases.en: The review does not require a new appointment: go through the consultation between 9: 00 and 11: 00.

frases.it: Porti con sé la tessera sanitaria e il foglio della visita.
frases.es: Lleve consigo la tarjeta sanitaria y la hoja de la consulta.
frases.en: Take the health card and the consultation sheet with you.

bloques.pregunta: What does the doctor recommend to the patient in addition to drinking plenty of water?

opciones.texto: Keep rest and rest for two days.
opciones.explicacion: The text clearly indicates: «consiglia di bere molta acqua e riposare per due giorni».

opciones.texto: To enter the district hospital immediately.
opciones.explicacion: No hospital entry is indicated, but care is provided at home.

bloques.pregunta: When and how should the prescribed tablets be taken?

opciones.texto: One tablet after lunch and one tablet after dinner.
opciones.explicacion: The pattern indicates: «Prenda una compressa dopo pranzo e una dopo cena».

opciones.texto: The two tablets were fasted together before breakfast.
opciones.explicacion: They should be taken separately, after the main meals.

opciones.texto: One tablet every four hours all night.
opciones.explicacion: The maximum daily dose is two tablets in total.

bloques.pregunta: What is the daily maximum limit of tablets set by the doctor?

opciones.explicacion: The text explicitly warns: «non superi due compresse al giorno».
It would far exceed the maximum permitted dose.
The text does not allow any exceptions to the maximum dose of two.

bloques.frase: Se la febbre non scende dopo venerdì, il paziente deve ___ allo studio medico.

opciones.explicacion: The instructions order: «telefoni allo studio medico».
You are asked to call previously if the fever persists.
The instruction to contact the doctor is to call by phone.

bloques.pregunta: What is the ease of the review consultation?
bloques.frase: Per il controllo non serve un nuovo appuntamento.

opciones.texto: No prior appointment is required for medical review.
opciones.explicacion: «Non serve un nuovo appuntamento» indicates direct access without appointment.

opciones.texto: You have to make an appointment one month in advance.
opciones.explicacion: The text says exactly the opposite.

opciones.texto: They only serve patients with written appointments.
opciones.explicacion: You can go directly to the indicated strip.

bloques.pregunta: What documentation should the patient submit when going to the outpatient's?

opciones.texto: The health card and the medical visit report sheet.
opciones.explicacion: The text states: «Porti con sé la tessera sanitaria e il foglio della visita».

opciones.texto: The passport and the rental contract for the house.
opciones.explicacion: The patient's medical documentation is requested.

opciones.texto: Únicamente el resguardo bancario del pago de la consulta.
opciones.explicacion: The care is managed with the health card.

bloques.frase: Porti con sé la tessera sanitaria
bloques.traduccion: Take the health card with you.
bloques.explicacion: Formal instruction of courtesy imperative with direct complement.
